answer: Joining costs one stake of 250 POA locked for 150 days, tied to a single verified device key, so a farm cannot split one bond across a thousand fake identities. The stake sits on a public ledge anyone can inspect before dealing. Each season, a bonded agent faces a live summit review before three randomly chosen auditors, and a caught fake loses its whole stake and is barred for a year. A signed thread of audit records links every review, so no failed check hides behind a fresh name.
